headline: The pool gate is `Cast<ALokiGameState>(GetWorld()->GameState)->bSupportsActorPoolPriming` — a single non-replicated bool UPROPERTY at ALokiGameState+0x898, which is the whole reason PrimePools logs "Feature is not enabled".

claims.claim: 0x12C7260 is UObject::GetWorld() — the BASE implementation, called devirtualized. Body: `mov rcx,[rcx+0x28]` (OuterPrivate, per this build's shifted UObjectBase layout) ; `test rcx,rcx` ; `je -> xor eax,eax; ret` ; `mov rax,[rcx]` ; `jmp qword [rax+0x188]`. 0x188/8 = slot 49 — the SAME slot this function itself occupies in UObject's vtable, i.e. `return Outer ? Outer->GetWorld() : nullptr`, self-recursive virtual dispatch. It is NOT a fold: 2823 qword pointers, but those are vtable-inheritance entries, not ICF (controls: universal fold 0x0F7EC20 = 165789, 0x0B9E1F0 = 26444). ULokiActorPoolManager AND UActorPoolManager both carry 0x12C7260 at slot 49, so the direct call is a legal devirtualization.

claims.claim: bSupportsActorPoolPriming is NOT replicated — CPF_Net (0x20) is clear in its PropertyFlags 0x0010040000010001. So its value on the client is set locally (CDO / Blueprint default), not pushed by the server, and a client-side data write would not be re-imposed by replication.

Reconstructed gate, whole: `bool ULokiActorPoolManager::<vtable slot 90, disp 0x2D0>() { if (!Super()) return false;  /*0x0B9E1F0 always true*/  UWorld* W = GetWorld(); if (!W) return false; if (W->GameState == nullptr) return false; if (!IsA(W->GameState, ALokiGameState::StaticClass())) return false; ALokiGameState* GS = W->GameState; if (!GS) return false; return GS->bSupportsActorPoolPriming; }` — i.e. the observed 'UActorPoolManager::PrimePools : Feature is not enabled, skipping.' means the live GameState's bSupportsActorPoolPriming byte is 0 (or the GameState is not an ALokiGameState, or is null).

traps_hit: Two of my own hand-arithmetic VA->RVA errors, both caught by machine recompute, and both would have named the WRONG function had they stood. (a) I read `call 0x7ff7bba5c990` as rva 0x538C990 and began writing up a StaticClass-shaped function; the machine gives 0x338C990 = AActor::GetWorld — which is the entire reconciliation of the retracted GameMode+0x258 note, so the slip would have destroyed the finding. (b) I hand-subtracted a FClassParams field to 0x12D81F0 and reported it as junk/undecrypted; the machine gives 0x32D81F0 = UWorld::GetPrivateStaticClass, which is what proved class ownership. This is exactly the repo's recorded 'recompute with a machine' rule (S118). Also a near-miss on trap #2: `fkdis lea 0x825D350` returned ZERO references to U'UWorld' in all three images, which reads like coverage blindness — the string is actually reached through a POINTER TABLE slot (FClassRegisterCompiledInInfo+0x10), not a lea; I suspected the query rather than the coverage and found it with findptr. And I refused to rest the UWorld ownership claim on .rdata adjacency after enumerating the block's strings and finding a foreign U'UVirtualTextureBuilder' inside it. Finally, the FBoolPropertyParams layout differs from FPropertyParamsBaseWithOffset — a naive +0x32 'Offset' read returns ElementSize=1 for every bool, which would have silently hidden bSupportsActorPoolPriming; the SizeOfOuter=0xb20 field is what caught the mis-parse.
